title.narrative: UN Women Gender Responsive Budgeting Västra Balkan 2020 - 2024
UN Women Gender Responsive Budgeting Western Balkans 2020 - 2024 - UN Women Gender Responsive Budgeting Western Balkans

description.narrative: Insatsen är ett stöd till UN Women för projektet "Transformative Financing for Gender Equality towards more Transparent, Inclusive and Accountable Governance in the Western Balkans". Projektet implementeras av UN Women på västra Balkan (huvudsakligen i (Bosnien och Herzegovina, Albanien, Kosovo och Serbien samt regionalt). Det övergripande målet med insatsen är att stärka jämställdhetsintegrering i samtliga delar av budgetprocesser inom myndigheter och offentliga institutioner på nationell och lokal nivå på västra Balkan. UN Women arbetar tillsammans med ansvariga institutioner i länderna, såsom finansministerier, jämställdhetsmyndigheter och kommuner, liksom med media och civilsamhälle.

The contribution is a support to UN Women for the project "Transformative Financing for Gender Equality towards more Transparent, Inclusive and Accountable Governance in the Western Balkans". The project is being implemented by UN Women in the Western Balkans with country level activities in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, and Serbia. In addition, there is a regional component where also North Macedonia is part. The overall goal of the project is to enhance systematic integration of gender equality at all stages of national and local policy making and budgeting processes in Western Balkan countries. UN Women works with responsible institutions in the countries, such as ministries of finances, gender machinery, supreme audit institutions, municipalities, as well as media and civil society.

Overall goal: Project countries (Bosnia and Herzegovina, Albania, Kosovo, and Serbia) systematically integrate gender equality and become more transparent at all stages of national and local policymaking and budgeting processes. Outcome 1: National and local governments apply gender responsive budgeting to integrate gender equality principles in public financing processes Output 1.1: Ministries of Finance, Line Ministries and National Gender Equality (GE) Machineries have knowledge and evidence to make informed budgetary allocation towards GE in line with national, and international commitments Output 1.2: Local governments have the capacity to apply Gender-Responsive Budgeting (GRB) tools in their plans and budgets Output 1.3: Government officials share knowledge and best practices across the region on GRB Outcome 2: Public oversight bodies, women including the disadvantaged, demand transparency and accountability of public policies and budgets to gender equality processes Output 2.1: Parliament and oversight bodies have capacities to monitor and advocate for gender responsive policies and budgets Output 2.2: Gender equality advocates are able to raise issues related to Financing for GE Output 2.3: Women, including the disadvantaged, are able to voice their needs and act as agents of change in planning and budgetary process Output 2.4: Oversight bodies are able to share knowledge and best practices across the region on GRB
